summary: Order placement 500s began at ~12:12Z, ~2.5 minutes after order-service v2.14.0 (dep-5101, 12:10Z) deployed a refactor that added MarginCheckValidator for F&O orders and removed legacy OrderRules.validateMargin(). All 426 errors are NullPointerExceptions in MarginCheckValidator.validate (line 88) with 'marginProfile is null', exclusively for orderType=FNO, producing HTTP 500 and an ~18% error rate that persists unchanged to 13:59Z. Alternative causes are ruled out: pricing-engine/exchange-gateway/ledger-db show no errors, no dependency or latency degradation, no CPU/memory/pool/restart signal, and the only config change (notification email batch size) is unrelated. Root cause is the bad deployment of the new validator's unguarded null dereference; remediation is rollback of dep-5101 / fix the null handling.

ranked_hypotheses.title: New MarginCheckValidator in dep-5101 dereferences a null margin profile for F&O orders
ranked_hypotheses.statement: order-service v2.14.0 (dep-5101, deployed 12:10Z) added MarginCheckValidator to the validation chain for F&O orders. The new validator reads a margin profile that is null/absent for FNO orders and dereferences it at MarginCheckValidator.java:88 without a null guard, throwing NullPointerException and returning HTTP 500. Because the faulty path is only reached for derivatives (FNO) orders, ~18% of traffic (the FNO share) fails while other order types are unaffected. Replacing legacy OrderRules.validateMargin() with the new validator removed the previously-working handling.

causal_chain.claim: dep-5101 deploys order-service v2.14.0 at 12:10Z introducing MarginCheckValidator
First NPE in MarginCheckValidator.validate at 12:12:31Z, 2.5 min later
All failures are orderType=FNO with 'marginProfile is null' -> HTTP 500
Error rate locks at ~18% (FNO share) with no recovery, no resource/pool/dependency signal

assumptions: The null margin profile is not itself caused by an upstream data change — no data-owning service deployed or changed config in the window.
MarginCheckValidator.java:88 is the dereference of the margin profile returned by the (assumed) lookup.
The FNO share of order traffic is ~18%, consistent with the observed error rate.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Upstream margin/profile data became missing for F&O accounts (data_issue)
ranked_hypotheses.statement: A margin-profile source (e.g., a reference/margin data store) stopped returning profiles for FNO accounts, so the validator received null even though its logic is correct; the deployment coincidence would then be incidental.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: No data-owning service deployed or changed config in the window (only dep-5088 portfolio-service grpc bump and cfg-2101 notification email batch size). The failure set is 100% FNO and tied to a brand-new code path; historically FNO orders worked with the legacy validator, so the missing profile only becomes fatal after the refactor removed the legacy handling. No telemetry shows a data source failing.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Dependency failure in pricing-engine / exchange-gateway / external exchange
ranked_hypotheses.statement: A downstream dependency (pricing-engine, exchange-gateway, or the external exchange-api) degraded and caused order placement 500s.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: pricing-engine, exchange-gateway and ledger-db produced zero ERROR logs over the whole window, and order-service latency stayed flat (~150ms, no timeouts/504s). The error is a local NullPointerException in order-service validation, not an upstream call failure.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Resource exhaustion / capacity saturation in order-service
ranked_hypotheses.statement: CPU, memory, DB connection pool or thread exhaustion in order-service produced the 500s.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: cpu ~40%, memory ~60%, db_pool_in_use ~14/15 with no saturation, zero restarts, and request_rate flat (~233 req/s). Errors are deterministic NPEs in a specific validator, not load-driven timeouts.

facts.statement: order-service error_rate rose from ~0.22% before 12:00 to 14.74% at 12:10 and ~18% thereafter.
426 ERROR entries, all NullPointerException in MarginCheckValidator.validate with orderType=FNO / 'marginProfile is null'.
dep-5101 (order-service v2.14.0) at 12:10Z added MarginCheckValidator and removed legacy OrderRules.validateMargin().
Deployment rollout completed at 12:10:08Z, before the first error at 12:12:31Z.
Only config change was notification-service email.batch_size 200->250, unrelated.
pricing-engine, exchange-gateway and ledger-db had zero ERROR logs; order-service latency/cpu/memory/request_rate flat.
No EQ (non-FNO) order errors occurred; failures are exclusively derivatives orders.
No order-service restarts; db_pool_in_use flat at ~14 connections.
Errors persist steadily to 13:58Z with no recovery.

assumptions: MarginCheckValidator.java:88 is where the (assumed) null margin profile is dereferenced; source not available in tools.
The null margin profile is produced/fetched within order-service rather than by an external data source, since no data-owning service deployed or changed config in the window.
The ~18% steady error rate equals the FNO share of order traffic.
query_logs results for order-service were truncated (426 matched, 40 returned) but two independent queries confirmed the same two error patterns and no other error types.

recommended_actions.action: Roll back order-service dep-5101 (v2.14.0) to the prior version to restore F&O order placement immediately.
recommended_actions.rationale: The faulty validator was introduced by this deployment; rollback removes the unguarded null dereference and is the fastest mitigation.

recommended_actions.action: Add a null guard / default handling for missing marginProfile in MarginCheckValidator.validate (line 88) and re-establish the F&O margin validation logic that the legacy OrderRules.validateMargin provided.
recommended_actions.rationale: Root cause is the unguarded dereference of a null margin profile for FNO orders.

recommended_actions.action: Add a canary/staged rollout with F&O-order synthetic checks so a validator regression is caught before full rollout.
recommended_actions.rationale: The bad deploy reached 100% of pods with no gate; FNO fraction of traffic (~18%) is enough to be detected in canary.

recommended_actions.action: Alert on per-order-type error rate and on NullPointerException patterns in validation, not just aggregate 5xx.
recommended_actions.rationale: Aggregate error_rate only flagged the issue ~10 min after onset; order-type scoping would localize it faster.

data_gaps: No trace/stack detail beyond 'MarginCheckValidator.java:88' or the source of marginProfile (DB query, cache, or field) — root cause is inferred from the deployment diff plus log message.
order-service error logs were truncated (truncated:true, 426 matched); a small number of non-FNO/non-margin errors cannot be strictly excluded, though two queries showed only the two FNO patterns.
No per-order-type request/error breakdown metric available to confirm quantitatively that the ~18% equals the FNO traffic share.
No data-service telemetry to fully prove margin-profile source data was healthy; ruled out only by absence of related deploys/config changes and by historical FNO success under the legacy validator.

findings.statement: order-service error_rate jumped from ~0.2% (pre-12:00) to ~14.7% in the 12:10 bucket and stayed ~18-19% through 13:59.
The first error log in order-service is at 12:12:31Z, inside the same 10-minute bucket where error_rate spiked; the incident onset is therefore ~12:12Z.

Every order-service error is a NullPointerException in the new MarginCheckValidator.validate, with 'marginProfile is null' and orderType=FNO. 426 ERROR entries total; 224 are the NPE pattern and 202 the rejection pattern.
Deployment dep-5101 (order-service v2.14.0, 12:10:00Z) introduced 'new MarginCheckValidator in validation chain' and removed 'legacy OrderRules.validateMargin()'; it is live and not rolled back.
The rollout-complete log for dep-5101 is at 12:10:08Z, ~2.5 minutes before the first error at 12:12:31Z.

refs.quote: deployment dep-5101 (v2.14.0) rollout complete, all pods ready

findings.statement: The only config change in the window is notification-service 'email.batch_size' 200->250 at 11:21Z, unrelated to order validation.

pricing-engine, exchange-gateway and ledger-db show zero ERROR logs across 08:00-13:59Z, and order-service latency_p99 (~150ms), cpu (~40%), memory (~60%) and request_rate (~233 req/s) are flat across the incident.
No EQ (non-derivative) order produced any error; only orderType=FNO orders appear in the failures, matching the report's 'mostly derivatives orders'.
No order-service restarts occurred during the window (restarts metric stays 0), and db_pool_in_use stays ~14 connections (no saturation).
Errors are continuous and steady from 12:12 to 13:58 (~18-19% error rate, no recovery), consistent with a persistent code defect rather than a transient blip or recovery.
